description: This file is a C++ source file implementing the SystemServices plugin for a WPEFramework-based device management system. It contains numerous method definitions for device info retrieval, firmware updates, mode settings, reboot handling, and various system control functionalities. It also includes class and method declarations, external library inclusions, callback registrations, and logic for system state management.

classes.name: firmwareUpdate
classes.description: A structure holding firmware update information such as version, HTTP status code, and success flag.

classes.name: SystemServices
classes.description: The main class implementing the SystemServices plugin, providing methods for device info, system control, firmware management, and system state notifications.

methods.name: getMocaStatus
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the Moca file to determine if Moca is enabled.

methods.name: setGzEnabled
methods.description: Stores the enabled status of GZ (some system feature) into a persistent file.

methods.name: collectDeviceInfo
methods.description: Reads system device information such as MAC addresses from temporary files.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Performs initialization of the SystemServices plugin, including setting default modes and registering methods.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters event handlers when the plugin is de-initialized.

methods.name: requestSystemReboot
methods.description: Requests a system reboot, optionally with a custom reason.

methods.name: setFirmwareRebootDelay
methods.description: Sets a delay time in seconds for firmware reboot via RFC parameter.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic firmware reboot after update.

methods.name: fireFirmwarePendingReboot
methods.description: Notifies the system about a pending firmware reboot within a specified delay.

methods.name: onFirmwarePendingReboot
methods.description: Sends a notification that firmware reboot is scheduled.

methods.name: onSystemPowerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles actions when system power state changes, such as triggering log uploads.

methods.name: onPwrMgrReboot
methods.description: Notifies other components about a reboot request issued by Power Manager.

methods.name: onNetorkModeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in network standby mode.

methods.name: requestEnableMoca
methods.description: Enables or disables Moca feature by creating/removing associated files.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Returns system uptime based on clock.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Fetches device information such as make, model, serial number, and other parameters.

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the manufacturing serial number via IARM call.

methods.name: getManufacturerData
methods.description: Fetches manufacturer data like model name or hardware ID from serialized system info.

methods.name: queryMocaStatus
methods.description: Returns whether Moca is enabled.

methods.name: onSystemModeChanged
methods.description: Notification handler for system mode changes.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Triggers firmware update process.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Provides current system mode and remaining duration.

methods.name: setBootLoaderPattern
methods.description: Sets the device's bootloader pattern (e.g., NORMAL, SILENT).

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Updates the bootloader splash screen image.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Changes system mode, optionally with a timer for duration.

methods.name: startModeTimer
methods.description: Starts a countdown timer for system mode duration.

methods.name: stopModeTimer
methods.description: Stops the mode timer countdown.

methods.name: isTimerActive
methods.description: Checks if mode timer is active.

methods.name: updateDuration
methods.description: Callback function invoked periodically to decrement remaining mode duration.

methods.name: reportFirmwareUpdateInfoReceived
methods.description: Reports the result of a firmware update check.

methods.name: getBootTypeInfo
methods.description: Query boot type information based on a system version file, determining if boot is normal, migration, update, or inconclusive.
